_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Handling Procedures for Static Sensitive Devices Report
summary: Documents the procedures employed by the contractor for the prevention of electrostatic damage to parts from handling of Static Sensitive Devices (SSD) and Printed Wiring Assemblies (PWA) containing SSDs.
description_purpose: The purpose of this report is to document the procedures employed by the contractor for the prevention of electrostatic damage to parts due to the handling of Static Sensitive Devices (SSD) and Printed Wiring Assemblies (PWA) containing SSDs.
application_interrelationship: This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract. This DID supersedes DI-T-5465A.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference documents.
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval date and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The report may be in the contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: This report shall contain the following information:

children.title: Training.
children.content: Training and recertification of personnel, including procedures, methods employed, and time intervals between training.

children.title: Labels.
children.content: Examples of all static sensitive labels to be used for identification.

children.title: Static sensitive handling.
children.content: A description and illustration of the area used for handling static sensitive parts/assemblies and associated items (e.g., static straps and mats, worktop materials, etc.).

children.title: Preparation instructions.
children.content: Preparation instructions for all equipments, including the test equipment, automated handling equipment, parts carrier, trays, carts, fixtures, tools, and soldering irons.

children.title: Special Equipment.
children.content: A list of all special equipment to be used for static protection (e.g., humidifiers, air ionizers, etc.).

children.title: Quality assurance procedures.
children.content: A description of the Quality Assurance procedures for monitoring equipment and work station adherence to the static safe procedures. This will include the following:

children.title: Name of the equipment used to check wrist wraps, bootstraps, and work stations for resistivity, and the schedules for these checks.
Procedures for the identification of equipment no longer meeting the required specification and methods for correcting the equipment to meet the specification.
Inspection.
children.content: Procedures to be followed during incoming inspection, storage, shipping, and in-plant transportation of wafers, die, packages and PWAs.

children.title: Disposition.
children.content: Procedures for the disposition of parts or assemblies received that are not in compliance with static-safe procedures.

children.title: Identification.
children.content: Procedures for the identification and classification of failures due to improper handling procedures.

children.title: Exceptions.
children.content: Specific exceptions to the procedures outlined in DOD-STD-1686 shall be noted.
